acceptance.item: P4-RT-05-01: eight controls that their own press makes inactive still take the HTML disabled attribute or leave the page, so keyboard focus falls to <body>
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/ownpress-focus.spec.ts > T2 "Show total" keeps the focus; T2 "Grow one layer" keeps the focus at the last layer; T7 table view: "Fire node 1" keeps the focus; T5 "Play to the end B" keeps the focus; board editor: "Add node" ... and "Remove node" ... keep the focus; Challenge: an accepted answer ... keeps the focus. Also site/tests/e2e/play-focus.spec.ts > OWN_PRESS cases (<what>: every aria-disabled control ignores Enter, Space and a click)
acceptance.evidence: Fixed except T10 (T10 cluster). Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base 967118d: reproducer 8 failed 'Expected: not "BODY"'. The adopted file without the two T10 cases failed 6 of 6 at base, and the 6 play-focus OWN_PRESS cases failed on the reverted source. Cause: the controls took the HTML disabled attribute in a state their own press brings about. They now carry aria-disabled in that state (disabled only before hydration, while frozen, while the editor is off, and for T2 grow in follow mode). Each handler returns by the same predicate (revealTotal, stepB, add and remove guards; T7's onclick checks canAct). The Challenge field is also readonly. Green: 28 passed with the other adopted specs, play-focus 49 passed with T06, final 182 passed. Commit e06e6b9.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-05-01 (sibling): T5 "Start the wave from all ones" and "Use this start" leave the page under their own press
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/ownpress-focus.spec.ts > T5 "Start the wave from all ones" hands the focus to the wave panel; T5 "Use this start" with all ones hands the focus to the start chooser
acceptance.evidence: Red at base: 2 failed (focusInTool Expected true, Received false). Cause: both buttons sit in {#if} blocks that their own press closes (waveText becomes null; startKind leaves 'custom' when the start is all ones or a fundamental weight). A focus left on either now moves inside the tool after tick(): to the tab panel (tabindex -1) or to the startKind select, as T4's keep counting does. Green: passed. Commit e06e6b9.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-05-02: opening 'Show as table' on T1, T8 or T9 at 320 widens the whole tool frame past the viewport
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/table-reflow.spec.ts > no page-level horizontal scroll at 320 with the table view of <tool> open on /<route> (5 cases)
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base: 5 failed, Expected 320, Received 585/338/385/361/417, the same as the verifier. Also red on the reverted source. Cause: .tool-frame had an implicit auto grid column, so a grid item's min-content (the open table) set the frame's width. Fix: grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr), so the existing overflow-x: auto of .bare scrolls the table in its own box. Green: 5 passed; a11y and nojs passed. Commit f676b3e.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-05-05: pressing Check with an answer that is not a whole number does nothing and says nothing (every prediction)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/predict-invalid.spec.ts > Check with the answer "two"/"1.5"/"" says why nothing happened; the sentence, the mark on the field, and their end
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base: 3 failed, 'Expected: not {invalid: null, result: "", said: []}'. The added exact-sentence test also failed on the reverted source. Cause: check() returned without a word when read() gave null. Now it writes 'Type a whole number.' (number question) or 'Type a whole number in each field.' (position question) into predictResult and the tool's live region. Each bad field gets aria-describedby on that line, and aria-invalid on a text field; editing clears both. An answered Check returns at once. Green: 5 passed, and predict-result and predict-focus passed. Commit 4745304.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-06-01: a control rendered disabled before hydration (and with JavaScript off) looks exactly like the enabled control
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/disabled-look.spec.ts > a disabled control does not look like the enabled one (5 adopted cases: tools/geometry, tools/fold, M7 b1, M6 b8, tools/board); without JavaScript every disabled control of every page has the shared look, whatever its component sets; a done control looks it: T2 Show total, T1 Step, Predict Check in T10 (M7 b4) and in T11 (M6 b7)
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base: reproducer 5 failed (identical style and screenshots); all 10 tests of the adopted file failed on the reverted source. Cause: no shared disabled style, and every component sets color and border for the usable look. Fix: one rule in site/src/styles/base.css for :is(button, input, select, textarea):is(:disabled, [aria-disabled='true']). It sets border-style: dashed and color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 65%, var(--page)), both !important so no scoped component rule overrides them. The toned text is 5.4:1 light and 6.9:1 dark (A-6). The focus ring is unchanged, so opacity was not used. T10 and T11 files were not edited; the sweep checks all 32 built pages without JavaScript, T10 and T11 routes included. Green: 10 passed; a11y and nojs passed. Commit 7267407.

deviations.spec: RT-FIX 5.3 (adoption changes only names, paths, selectors)
deviations.what: The own-press reproducer was adopted without its two T10 tests. The label-in-name reproducer was adopted only for tools/mirror, into T06.spec.ts regressions. In table-reflow and ownpress-focus, the class selectors details.table-view and figure.tool-figure became the summary 'Show as table' (as T08, T10 and T15 specs open it) and the frame's figure.

openQuestions: T10.spec.ts 'no long task on E8 loads and the graph switch' and 'no long task after a ring click on the largest main-thread configuration' fail now and then on this shared machine (long tasks of 51 to 141 ms at load average 5 to 16). An alternating A/B run failed on both the base build and the fixed build (base round 3: 3 of 4 failed). They are timing noise, not caused by this branch; MERGE should rerun them on a quiet machine.

On a board that is not hydrated yet or is frozen by a prediction, the drawn second ring of 6.3 ('may act here') is unchanged. The node buttons are transparent hit areas, so the shared rule shows nothing on a drawn board. Dashing the ring would clash with the dashed mark circles of T9 and the board editor. If the owner wants frozen boards to look frozen, that needs a separate visual decision.
handoff: Shared files outside the per-tool area: site/src/styles/base.css (a global rule on every page), ToolFrame.svelte, Predict.svelte and BoardEditor.svelte (every tool), and site/src/components/lesson/Challenge.svelte; also play-focus.spec.ts (OWN_PRESS cases added, nameOf now names data-table-node). The T10 fixer takes the T10 parts of P4-RT-05-01 and P4-RT-05-07. If they adopt the own-press reproducer as site/tests/e2e/ownpress-focus.spec.ts too, MERGE will get an add/add conflict there: keep both sets of tests. T10 and T11 get the disabled look from base.css with no edit to their files. For the lens rerun: on P4-RT-06-01 the proposed opacity was not used because it would fade the focus ring of done controls that keep the focus (A-2, A-6), and 'covers frozen boards' does not reach the drawn rings (see openQuestions). P4-RT-05-02, P4-RT-05-05 and P4-RT-05-07 follow their proposed fixes; P4-RT-05-05 differs only in giving radio buttons no aria-invalid.
